# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 and new filter APIs** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 upgrades to Skia m150 and adds image filter, color filter, and fast-bounds APIs. This release lands new image-processing APIs and a performance improvement for SKSurface. It also completes the v4 breaking-change story by promoting remaining obsoletes to compile errors and removing .NET Interactive support.

## Breaking Changes

- **Remaining pre-v4 obsolete members promoted to compile errors** — SKPaint text/font members and enum values that were marked [Obsolete] in v3 now emit compile errors in v4. Migration: switch to SKFont for text sizing and typeface assignment and remove references to the obsolete enum values. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **.NET Interactive support removed** — The SkiaSharp .NET Interactive and Polyglot Notebooks integration package has been removed. If you depend on it, pin to 4.148.x or migrate to the standard SkiaSharp NuGet package. ([#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Engine

- **Skia upgraded to milestone m150** — The bundled Skia engine is now built from chrome/m150 and includes a further upstream bug-fix sync. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146), [#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## API Surface

- **SKPaint.GetFastBounds() supports quick-reject culling** — The new method returns a conservative paint bounds estimate, enabling fast visibility checks without a full draw pass. ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))
- **New image-filter factories** — SKImageFilter gains CreateCrop() for cropping a filter chain's output and CreateEmpty() for producing transparent output. ([#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228))
- **Overdraw visualization color filter** — SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw() maps overdraw counts to a configurable color ramp for visualizing rendering hotspots. ([#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small-sigma raster blur regression fixed** — Raster rendering again uses the correct blur path for small sigma values. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKSurface.Canvas wrapper cached across calls** — SKSurface now reuses its managed Canvas wrapper, avoiding repeated allocations in render loops. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## Security

- **HarfBuzz updated to 14.2.1** — The bundled text-shaping dependency is refreshed to HarfBuzz 14.2.1. ([#4167](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4167))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
